items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: C.L. asked me if I wanted to work in his band

ctx.x: April of the next year, which is 1943 now, C.L. asked me if I wanted to work in his band, because the trumpet player he was was George Arndorff--do you know him?
George Arndorff, yes; didn't he at one time work with Kid Ory?
